reached_sql:
SELECT i.i_item_id, ca.ca_country, ca.ca_state, ca.ca_county,
       avg(cast(cs.cs_quantity as decimal(12,2))) AS agg1,
       avg(cast(cs.cs_list_price as decimal(12,2))) AS agg2,
       avg(cast(cs.cs_coupon_amt as decimal(12,2))) AS agg3,
       avg(cast(cs.cs_sales_price as decimal(12,2))) AS agg4,
       avg(cast(cs.cs_net_profit as decimal(12,2))) AS agg5,
       avg(cast(c.c_birth_year as decimal(12,2))) AS agg6,
       avg(cast(cd1.cd_dep_count as decimal(12,2))) AS agg7
FROM catalog_sales cs
JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN (SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_dep_count FROM customer_demographics WHERE cd_gender = 'F' AND cd_education_status = 'Primary') AS cd1 ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk
JOIN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2001) AS d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd2 ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk
JOIN (SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_country, ca_state, ca_county FROM customer_address WHERE ca_state IN ('AL','MO','TN','GA','MT','IN','CA')) AS ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN (SELECT 1 AS c_birth_month UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 4) AS bm ON c.c_birth_month = bm.c_birth_month
GROUP BY ROLLUP (i.i_item_id, ca.ca_country, ca.ca_state, ca.ca_county)
ORDER BY ca.ca_country, ca.ca_state, ca.ca_county, i.i_item_id
LIMIT 100
